test_cases.path_step: Open modify course modal for deletion
test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 6: COURSE LIFECYCLE (COURSE DELETION) - Phase 2: Test Course Deletion Process
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Opens Modify Course Modal for Deletion
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with a pre-provisioned account is logged into the system and is on the 'Dashboard Page'. A course titled 'Temporary Course for Deletion' exists and is visible on the dashboard.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Modify Course' modal should open, displaying the course details for 'Temporary Course for Deletion'. The 'Delete' button within the modal should be present but initially disabled until the 'Allow Deletion' checkbox is ticked.
test_cases.post_condition: The 'Modify Course' modal is open, showing the details for 'Temporary Course for Deletion'.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Edit Course' button next to the 'Temporary Course for Deletion' course
